name: M5 forecasting
description: Predicting product sales of large retail companies is a challenging task considering volatile nature of trends, seasonalities, events as well as unknown factors such as market competitions, change in customer's preferences, or unforeseen events, e.g., COVID-19 outbreak. In this paper, we benchmark forecasting models on historical sales data from Walmart to predict their future sales. We provide a comprehensive theoretical overview and analysis of the state-of-the-art timeseries forecasting models. Then, we apply these models on the forecasting challenge dataset (M5 forecasting by Kaggle). Specifically, we use a traditional model, namely, ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average), and recently developed advanced models e.g., Prophet model developed by Facebook, light gradient boosting machine (LightGBM) model developed by Microsoft and benchmark their performances. reputation: The M5 competition is one of the most widely recognized retail forecasting benchmarks and a standard reference point for hierarchical demand forecasting.
notes: Kaggle-style benchmark with hierarchical evaluation; strong dependence on feature engineering and ensembling. Public leaderboard results can be affected by overfitting to the validation setup.
